source.title: WAT Leader Announcement (August 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Sherry Tao will become the new Leader of the WCA Archive Team (WAT). Sherry was already working as a Member of the WAT.

<!-- break -->
Sherry was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of August 14, 2026.

We thank William Gan for the work he has done as the Leader, and wish Sherry the best of luck in fulfilling her new duties.

Sherry’s public application can be viewed [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sWB33p6HPThS80ZtHUqQAIYmMGgtw64c?usp=sharing). We also received several applications from potential future members of the WAT; we look forward to seeing the Team grow and carry out its duties under Sherry’s leadership.

translation.title: WAT 负责人任命公告（2026 年 8 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴宣布，Sherry Tao 将担任 WCA 档案团队（WAT）的新任负责人。Sherry 此前已是 WAT 的成员。

WCA 董事会依据《WCA 委员会与团队[议案](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf)》第 5 节，选出 Sherry，并通过投票批准了这一任命。任命自 2026 年 8 月 14 日生效。

我们感谢 William Gan 担任负责人期间所做的工作，并祝 Sherry 在新的岗位上一切顺利。

Sherry 的公开申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sWB33p6HPThS80ZtHUqQAIYmMGgtw64c?usp=sharing)查看。我们还收到了几份希望成为 WAT 新成员的申请，期待团队在 Sherry 的领导下发展壮大并履行职责。
